mapper.sql: select h.calc_hist_id as "calcHistId", h.target_user_id as "targetUserId", case when k.name is not null then k.name else u.login_id end as "targetUserName", h.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", h.area_code as "areaCode", h.source_achievement_id as "sourceAchievementId", h.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", h.base_score as "baseScore", h.participation_type as "participationType", h.distribution_rate as "distributionRate", h.cap_applied_yn as "capAppliedYn", h.formula_version_id as "formulaVersionId", h.generation_no as "generationNo", h.calculated_score as "calculatedScore", h.request_id as "requestId", h.calculated_at as "calculatedAt" from biz_score_calc_hist h join users u on u.user_id = h.target_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots k on k.employee_no = u.employee_no
mapper.select: order by h.evaluation_year desc, h.calculated_at desc, h.calc_hist_id limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into business_process_audit_logs (action_type, target_key, before_state, after_state, actor_user_id, result_status, request_id, created_at) values ('BATCH', #{targetKey}, null, cast(#{afterStateJson} as jsonb), #{actorUserId}, 'SUCCESS', #{requestId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
